title: The dualizing multiplication unit has the prescribed finite reductions
statement: Fix l,E,X,D,hl with l prime and distinct from the characteristic of D, E finite over the l-adic field and X separated finite type over Spec(D.k), as in [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-core]. Let wE be a coherent integral dualizing datum [def-sf-coherent-integral-dualizing-datum]. At every n≥0, reduction of the specified multiplication unit on wE.omega followed by wE.reduction_n equals the identity-extension quotient comparison followed by scalar extension of wE.reduction_n and then the counit-defined finiteU_n [def-sf-integral-finite-extension-models]. This is an equality at a single finite quotient and asserts no equality of integral morphisms.

proof.text: Expand quotient into inverse completion, finiteReductionIso, the coefficient tensor square, and the source finiteReductionIso. Naturality of finiteReductionIso cancels the completion factors against those in unit. The identity coefficient map induces the identity at each quotient.

The counit-defined finite exceptional comparison for identity coefficients is the scalar multiplication unit by adjunction triangle identities, as in finiteDualizingCoefficientComparisons. The scalar-unit-normalized pro-etale realization preserves this identity. Substitute it in the tensor square; naturality of multiplication with respect to (wE.reduction n).hom proves the claimed square. The same formulas cover n=0, zero dualizing objects and empty X.

theorem unit_dualizing_reduction
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (wE : DualizingDatum l X D hl E)
    (n : ℕ) :
    (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).map
        (unit l E X wE.omega.obj wE.omega.property.1).hom ≫ (wE.reduction n).hom =
      (quotient l E E (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E) X n
          wE.omega.obj wE.omega.property.1).hom ≫
        (pbcDerivedExtend (integralScalarQuotientSheafMap l E E
          (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E) X n)).map (wE.reduction n).hom ≫
        finiteU l E E (AlgHom.id (Padic l) E) X D n
